### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **velov:** Block data collection : better Matomo optout ([23d844a](https://github.com/cesbar/zpatches/commit/23d844a3bf8d4d07509edd05950b80379ff4f4ca))

### ✨ New Features

* **velov:** Use multiple devices ([a66323b](https://github.com/cesbar/zpatches/commit/a66323b5788fef4e76f077337ff05ca067a867af))

patches.name: Google Maps API key
patches.description: Use a different Google Maps API key to fix modified apps

patches.name: Block data collection
patches.description: Block Didomi & Matomo tracking SDKs, hide consent prompts for 3rd party & geolocation data

patches.name: Easy deeplinks configuration
patches.description: Allows easy configuration of deeplinks (velov.cyclocity.fr, velov.grandlyon.com) required by the app to sign-in

patches.name: Hide onboarding screen
patches.description: Hide the onboarding "Plan you journey" screen

patches.name: No geolocalisation check
patches.description: Allows you to unlock a bike even if you're not near the station.

patches.name: Spoof package signature
patches.description: Spoofs the package signature required for Firebase, fixes notifications

patches.name: Use multiple devices
patches.description: Fix the login error "Access denied. This account is already in use on another device." by pretending to be the web client

patches.name: Bypass PairIp
patches.description: Bypass the PairIp license check preventing app modification

patches.description: Disable Internet and Telemetry by removing all non-necessary permissions from the manifest
